Banzai Charge.description: Though the ronin has forsaken the warrior's code and sacrificed some portion of his honor, he retains the fierce courage that once defined him. Starting at 2nd level, whenever a ronin charges an opponent, he may voluntarily take an additional penalty to his Armor Class in order to gain an equal bonus on his damage roll. The standard -2 AC penalty from charging still applies and is included in the total, but the ronin may not choose a penalty less than -2 or greater than his base attack bonus. For instance, a 2nd-level ronin performing a banzai charge could accept a -8 AC penalty to receive a +8 bonus to damage.

Bonus Feat.description: Through extensive combat experience, the ronin has acquired a broad array of fighting techniques. At 5th level and again at 9th level, the ronin selects one feat from the following options: Far Shot, Improved Precise Shot, Manyshot, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Ride-By Attack, Shot on the Run, Spirited Charge, Trample. All prerequisites for the chosen feat must still be satisfied.

Infamy.description: Whether or not the ronin truly deserves it, a reputation for dishonor precedes him wherever he goes. When a person of authority learns of the ronin's background (typically via a DC 10 Gather Information or Knowledge (nobility and royalty) check), that individual's initial attitude is one step worse than it would normally be, and the ronin suffers a -4 circumstance penalty on all Charisma-based checks made when dealing with that person. This penalty only takes effect if the authority figure is aware of who the ronin actually is, which leads many ronin to travel under assumed names or disguised identities.

Sneak Attack.description: When a ronin strikes a foe who is unable to properly defend against the attack, he can target a vulnerable area for an additional 1d6 points of damage. This bonus damage increases by 1d6 every three levels thereafter (+2d6 at 4th level, +3d6 at 7th level, and +4d6 at 10th level).

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: Ronins do not gain proficiency with any additional weapons or armor.

classFeatures.description: The ronin's reputation for dishonor-deserved or not-follows him everywhere. Whenever someone in a position of authority has heard of the ronin's past (usually through a DC 10 Gather Information or Knowledge (nobility and royalty) check), that person's attitude starts one category worse than usual, and the ronin takes a -4 circumstance penalty on all Charisma-based checks involving that person. The infamy penalty applies only if the authority figure knows the ronin's identity, so some ronin adopt pseudonyms or secret identities.
classFeatures.name: Infamy

classFeatures.description: If a ronin can catch an opponent when she is unable to defend herself effectively from his attack, he can strike a vital spot for an extra 1d6 points of damage. This extra damage increases by 1d6 points every third level (+2d6 at 4th level, +3d6 at 7th level, +4d6 at 10th level). For complete details on the sneak attack ability, see the description of the dark hunter earlier in this chapter.
classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack

classFeatures.description: The ronin has cast away the code of bushido and at least a measure of his own honor, but his heart still remembers the thrill of bravery. When a ronin of 2nd level or higher charges into battle, he can accept a variable penalty to his Armor Class and take an equivalent bonus on the damage roll. The normal -2 AC penalty for charging still applies and counts toward the bonus, but the ronin cannot accept a penalty smaller than -2 or larger than his base attack bonus. For example, a 2nd-level ronin making a banzai charge could take a -8 penalty to AC in exchange for a +8 bonus on the damage roll.
classFeatures.name: Banzai Charge

classFeatures.description: The ronin's experience in battle has taught him many tricks and techniques. At 5th and 9th level, a ronin may choose one feat from the following list: Far Shot, Improved Precise Shot, Manyshot, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Ride-By Attack, Shot on the Run, Spirited Charge, Trample. The ronin must still meet all the prerequisites for the bonus feat.
classFeatures.name: Bonus Feat

raw.description: A ronin is a masterless warrior cast adrift in the world, but still clinging to the remnants of his former life.
raw.name: Ronin

special: Must have fled or been exiled from the service of a feudal lord, commonly for disobeying orders, displaying rudeness or cowardice at a crucial juncture, or failing in a crucial task.
